item.title: ACM Awards 2026 Predictions: Who Will Take Home Top Honors?
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our ACM Awards preview. This Sunday, May 17, the biggest names in country music will gather at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas to find out who will take home the top prizes. And this year, it's all about the ladies, with women leading the nominations."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Megan Moroney is at the top with nine nods, followed closely by Miranda Lambert with eight, and Ella Langley and Lainey Wilson with seven each. Wilson and Moroney are also up for the coveted Entertainer of the Year award, alongside Luke Combs, Cody Johnson, Chris Stapleton, Jelly Roll, and Morgan Wallen."
[Short music transition]
Host: "If Luke Combs wins, he'll achieve the ACM's triple crown, having already won New Male Artist and Male Artist of the Year. And if Lainey Wilson takes the prize, she'll join Carrie Underwood as the only woman to win it three times, and would be the first to win it three years in a row."
[Short music transition]
Host: "We already know a few of the winners, with Tucker Wetmore taking New Male Artist of the Year, Avery Anna winning New Female Artist of the Year, Stephen Wilson Jr.'s 'Cuckoo' music video winning Visual Media of the Year, and Jessie Jo Dillon earning Songwriter of the Year."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Shania Twain will host the show, which will stream live on Prime Video for the fifth year in a row. Tune in this Sunday to find out who will take home the top prizes. We'll be watching, and we can't wait to see who emerges victorious."
[Outro music plays]
